messages.content:
```
df -h
```
Shows total, used and free space for each mounted filesystem.

```
find ~ -name "*.log"
```
Searches the home directory tree for matching names.

```
grep -rn "TODO" src/
```
`-r` recurses directories, `-n` shows line numbers.

```
ps aux | grep python
```
Pipe to grep to filter the process you want.

```
kill 1234
```
Replace 1234 with the PID from `ps`. Use `-9` only when normal kill fails.

```
ss -tlnp
```
Lists TCP ports in listening state with owning processes.

```
chmod +x run.sh
```
Adds the execute bit so `./run.sh` works.

```
tar -xzf app.tar.gz
```
Create one with `tar -czf app.tar.gz mydir/`.
Show the end of a log file live

```
tail -f /var/log/syslog
```
`-f` follows new lines; Ctrl+C to stop.

```
wc -l data.jsonl
```
Also try `wc -w` for words and `wc -c` for bytes.
Show first lines of a file

```
head -20 app.log
```
Last lines with `tail -20 app.log`.

```
mkdir -p data/raw data/processed
```
`-p` creates parents and skips existing dirs.

```
cp -r src/ backup/
```
`-r` copies the whole tree including subfolders.

```
mv old.txt new.txt
```
Same command moves across directories too.

```
file model.gguf
```
Inspects magic bytes, e.g. data vs text vs archive.

```
sudo smartctl -H /dev/sda
```
Needs smartmontools; PASSED means the disk reports healthy.

```
free -h
```
Shows RAM + swap totals, used and available.

```
nvidia-smi
```
Lists GPUs, VRAM use and running processes per GPU.

```
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
```
Deactivate later with the `deactivate` command.

```
pip install -r requirements.txt
```
Freeze current env with `pip freeze > requirements.txt`.

```
ssh user@192.168.1.10
```
Accept the fingerprint on first connect; keys avoid passwords.

```
scp model.gguf user@host:/tmp/
```
Add `-r` for directories.

```
pwd
whoami
```
`pwd` prints the working directory, `whoami` the login name.

```
env | grep -i proxy
```
Never print secrets to shared logs.

```
git checkout -b feat-x
git push -u origin feat-x
```
Undo last commit but keep changes

```
git reset --soft HEAD~1
```
Files stay staged; use `--mixed` to unstage instead.

```
docker ps
```
Add `-a` to include stopped containers.

```
docker logs -f myapp
```
`-f` streams; `--tail 100` shows the last 100 lines first.

```
docker stop $(docker ps -q)
```
`docker ps -q` lists only running container IDs.

```
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8080/health
```
Empty reply means nothing listens there.

```
curl -L -o file.gguf https://example.com/file.gguf
```
`-L` follows redirects, `-o` sets the output name.

```
ls -la
```
First column like `-rwxr-xr-x` is the permission string.

```
sudo chown user:group file.txt
```
Needs sudo unless you already own the file.

```
find / -xdev -type f -size +1G 2>/dev/null
```
`-xdev` stays on one filesystem; errors hidden.

```
nproc
lscpu | head -20
```
`nproc` prints the thread count for `-j` flags.

```
watch -n 2 nvidia-smi
```
Re-runs every 2 seconds; Ctrl+C to stop.
Run a command in background with log

```
nohup python3 train.py > train.log 2>&1 &
```
Survives logout; PID printed; check with `jobs`.

```
zip -r backup.zip mydir/
```
Unzip with `unzip backup.zip`.

```
diff -u old.txt new.txt | head -40
```
`-u` gives unified context format.

```
sort data.txt | uniq -c | sort -nr | head
```
Classic frequency-count pipeline.

```
sed -i 's/foo/bar/g' *.txt
```
`-i` edits in place; test without `-i` first.

```
ls -l /proc/1234/fd
```
Replace 1234 with the PID; useful for deleted-but-open files.

```
sudo apt update
```
Upgrades with `sudo apt upgrade -y` after that.

```
systemctl status myapp
```
Restart with `sudo systemctl restart myapp`.
